promptOutlines.grammar: Grammar pattern name; meaning; structure; usage and cautions; at least 3 Japanese examples with Vietnamese translations.
promptOutlines.vocabulary: One entry per line in this format: Japanese word?reading?? Vietnamese meaning. Group words by topic; add Japanese?Vietnamese example sentences where useful.
promptOutlines.lesson: Topic and learning goals; key vocabulary/patterns; a natural dialogue of about 6 turns with a Vietnamese translation for every line; brief usage notes.
promptOutlines.culture: Introduce the cultural topic; provide context, etiquette or related expressions; include at least 3 Japanese?Vietnamese examples or phrases.
promptOutlines.example: State the pattern or practice goal; provide at least 5 Japanese sentences with Vietnamese translations and brief notes where helpful.
promptOutlines.default: Title; learning goal; main content; Japanese examples with Vietnamese translations; references if any.

segmentTranslations.hom_nay_ban_den_luc_may_gio: What time did you arrive today?
segmentTranslations.vay_a_lop_hoc_bat_dau_tu_chin_gio_nhi: I see. Class starts at nine, right?
segmentTranslations.vang_chung_ta_cung_den_lop_nhe: Yes. Let us go to class together.
segmentTranslations.chu_nhat_ban_lam_gi: What do you do on Sundays?
segmentTranslations.buoi_sang_toi_hoc_tieng_nhat_o_nha: I study Japanese at home in the morning.
segmentTranslations.buoi_chieu_toi_xem_phim_voi_ban: I watch a movie with a friend in the afternoon.
segmentTranslations.phim_nhu_the_nao: What kind of movie is it?
segmentTranslations.do_la_mot_bo_phim_nhat_moi: It is a new Japanese movie.
segmentTranslations.hay_qua_chuc_ban_vui_nhe: That sounds great. Enjoy the movie!
segmentTranslations.cho_toi_mot_phan_ca_ri: I would like one curry, please.
segmentTranslations.quy_khach_dung_do_uong_gi_khong_a: Would you like something to drink?
segmentTranslations.mot_ca_ri_va_mot_nuoc_loc_a: One curry and one water, right?
segmentTranslations.xin_loi_nha_ga_o_dau_a: Excuse me, where is the station?
segmentTranslations.xin_hay_di_thang_con_duong_nay: Please go straight along this road.
segmentTranslations.toi_re_phai_o_cho_den_giao_thong_phai_kh: Should I turn right at the traffic light?
segmentTranslations.di_bo_den_ga_mat_may_phut: How many minutes does it take to walk to the station?
segmentTranslations.ban_co_mua_quyt_nua_khong: Would you like some mandarins too?
segmentTranslations.tong_cong_la_nam_tram_yen: That comes to 500 yen in total.
segmentTranslations.xin_hay_cho_toi_xem_the_hoc_sinh: May I see your student ID?
segmentTranslations.ngay_tra_sach_la_thu_hai_tuan_sau: The book is due next Monday.
segmentTranslations.toi_la_nguyen_da_dat_phong_hai_dem_tu_ho: I am Nguyen. I have a reservation for two nights starting today.
segmentTranslations.de_toi_kiem_tra_dat_phong_xin_vui_long_d: Let me check your reservation. Please wait a moment.
segmentTranslations.da_xac_nhan_duoc_dat_phong_xin_ghi_ten_v: Your reservation is confirmed. Please write your name here.
segmentTranslations.tu_bay_den_muoi_gio_tai_nha_hang_tang_ha: It is served from 7 to 10 at the restaurant on the second floor.
segmentTranslations.toi_muon_doi_lich_hen_ngay_mai: I would like to reschedule my appointment for tomorrow.
segmentTranslations.toi_dat_lich_luc_muoi_gio_sang: I have an appointment at 10 a.m.
segmentTranslations.neu_buoi_chieu_thi_con_trong_luc_ba_gio: We have an opening at 3 p.m.
segmentTranslations.vay_cho_toi_doi_sang_ba_gio: Then, please change it to 3 p.m.
segmentTranslations.vang_chung_toi_da_doi_lich_chuc_ban_mau_: Certainly. We have changed your appointment. I hope you feel better soon.
segmentTranslations.thu_bay_toi_ban_di_bien_cung_toi_khong: Would you like to go to the beach with me next Saturday?
segmentTranslations.duoc_day_may_gio_chung_ta_xuat_phat: That sounds good. What time shall we leave?
segmentTranslations.hay_gap_nhau_o_ga_luc_tam_gio_sang: Let us meet at the station at 8 in the morning.
segmentTranslations.u_nhi_toi_se_mua_ve_truoc: That is true. I will buy the tickets in advance.
segmentTranslations.cam_on_ban_toi_dang_mong_cho_chuyen_di: Thanks. I am looking forward to the trip.
segmentTranslations.ban_co_the_kiem_tra_tai_lieu_nay_trong_h: Could you check this document sometime today?
segmentTranslations.duoc_ban_can_truoc_may_gio: Sure. What time do you need it by?
segmentTranslations.neu_duoc_nho_ban_hoan_thanh_truoc_bon_gi: If possible, please finish it by 4 p.m.
segmentTranslations.toi_hieu_roi_toi_se_gui_truoc_cuoc_hop: Understood. I will send it before the meeting.
segmentTranslations.the_thi_tot_qua_neu_co_diem_nao_thay_doi: Great. Please let me know if anything changes.
segmentTranslations.vang_toi_se_kiem_tra_roi_lien_lac: Okay. I will check and get back to you.
segmentTranslations.nghe_noi_ngay_mai_troi_se_mua_day: I hear it will rain tomorrow.
segmentTranslations.that_sao_toi_nen_mang_o_theo_nhi: Really? I should take an umbrella, then.
segmentTranslations.nghe_noi_tu_chieu_mua_se_nang_hat_hon: Apparently, the rain will get heavier in the afternoon.
segmentTranslations.vay_thi_hom_nay_toi_se_giat_do_truoc: In that case, I will do the laundry today.
segmentTranslations.lam_vay_co_ve_tot_day: That sounds like a good idea.
segmentTranslations.cam_on_ban_da_cho_toi_biet_du_bao_thoi_t: Thanks for telling me the weather forecast.
segmentTranslations.de_den_osaka_toi_nen_di_chuyen_tau_nao: Which train should I take to get to Osaka?
segmentTranslations.hay_doi_sang_tau_nhanh_o_ga_tiep_theo: Change to the express train at the next station.
segmentTranslations.tau_nay_co_dung_o_ga_tiep_theo_khong: Does this train stop at the next station?
segmentTranslations.co_tau_se_den_san_ga_so_ba: Yes. It arrives at platform three.
segmentTranslations.doi_tau_co_mat_nhieu_thoi_gian_khong: Does it take long to change trains?
segmentTranslations.tai_lieu_cho_cuoc_hop_da_xong_chua: Have the materials for the meeting been finished?
segmentTranslations.roi_sang_nay_toi_da_kiem_tra_truoc_noi_d: Yes. I checked the contents this morning.
segmentTranslations.cam_on_ban_ban_da_nho_truong_phong_xem_c: Thanks. Have you asked the department manager to review them?
segmentTranslations.van_chua_toi_se_gui_truoc_cuoc_hop: Not yet. I will send them before the meeting.
segmentTranslations.may_qua_neu_co_thay_doi_thi_hay_bao_cho_: Great. Please let me know if anything changes.
segmentTranslations.toi_hieu_roi_toi_se_lien_lac_ngay: Understood. I will contact you right away.
segmentTranslations.xin_loi_toi_nen_di_the_nao_de_den_khach_: Excuse me, how can I get to the hotel?
segmentTranslations.hay_di_thang_duong_nay_roi_re_phai_o_goc: Go straight along this road, then turn right at the second corner.
segmentTranslations.khach_san_do_o_gan_nha_ga_phai_khong_a: Is that hotel near the station?
segmentTranslations.dung_vay_ra_khoi_ga_ban_se_thay_mot_bien: That is right. When you leave the station, you will see a large sign on your left.
segmentTranslations.di_bo_mat_khoang_bao_lau_a: How long does it take to walk there?
segmentTranslations.khoang_muoi_phut_co_ve_troi_sap_mua_nen_: About ten minutes. It looks like it may rain, so please be careful.
segmentTranslations.con_mot_thang_nua_la_den_ky_thi_nhi_ban_: There is only one month until the exam. How is your preparation going?
segmentTranslations.phan_ngu_phap_gan_xong_roi_nhung_toi_van: I am almost done with grammar, but listening is still difficult for me.
segmentTranslations.ban_nen_tap_nghe_tung_chut_moi_ngay: You should practice listening a little every day.
segmentTranslations.dung_nhi_toi_se_thu_nghe_tin_tuc_tieng_n: That is true. I will try listening to Japanese news on my way to school.
segmentTranslations.neu_tra_truoc_nhung_tu_chua_hieu_sau_do_: If you look up unfamiliar words afterward, they will be easier to remember.
segmentTranslations.y_hay_day_toi_se_thu_lam_tu_hom_nay: That is a good idea. I will start today.
segmentTranslations.chung_ta_da_hen_di_xem_phim_vao_thu_bay_: We were planning to go see a movie on Saturday, right?
segmentTranslations.xin_loi_nhe_dot_nhien_toi_co_viec_phai_l: I am sorry. Something came up at work unexpectedly.
segmentTranslations.vay_a_neu_la_chu_nhat_thi_toi_co_thoi_gi: I see. I am free on Sunday.
segmentTranslations.may_qua_chung_ta_hen_gap_vao_chieu_chu_n: Great. Shall we meet on Sunday afternoon instead?
segmentTranslations.duoc_day_sau_khi_xem_phim_chung_ta_cung_: Sounds good. Let us get something to eat after the movie too.
segmentTranslations.toi_mong_den_luc_do_qua_vay_chung_ta_hen: I cannot wait. Let us meet at the station, then.
segmentTranslations.tim_viec_o_nhat_co_vat_va_khong_a: Was it difficult to find a job in Japan?
segmentTranslations.ban_dau_toi_khong_biet_cach_viet_so_yeu_: At first, I had trouble because I did not know how to write a resume.
segmentTranslations.anh_chi_co_hoi_y_kien_ai_khong_a: Did you ask anyone for advice?
segmentTranslations.toi_nho_giao_vien_o_truong_xem_giup_roi_: I asked a teacher at school to review it, and revised it several times.
segmentTranslations.trong_buoi_phong_van_ho_da_hoi_nhung_gi_: What did they ask you during the interview?
segmentTranslations.ho_hoi_ve_kinh_nghiem_truoc_day_va_toi_m: They asked about my past experience and what I would like to do if I joined the company.
